title: Ledger intermediate document
description: Tool-independent intermediate representation of this fleet's bespoke markdown ledgers (TODO.md / TODO.archive.md / ROADMAP.md / ROADMAP.archive.md / REVIEW_ME.md). Produced by tracker/ledger-map.py, consumed by the Plane and Vikunja adapters (id:90f2). Prose contract: tracker/SCHEMA.md. TODO id:2bb1.

schema_version.description: Contract-surface version marker, and the SINGLE SOURCE every derived consumer reads (tracker/repo-entity.py, tracker/adapters/adapter_common.py); tracker/ledger-map.py's SCHEMA_VERSION literal is pinned to it by its own cross-check. This repo has NO repo-wide version (CLAUDE.md Versioning); this marker exists because a stale adapter reading a changed document fails SILENTLY. Bump on any change to required keys, to an enum, OR to a documented VALUE SPACE — replacing the values a property may take is semantically non-additive even when no key is added or removed (that is what 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 records: repos[].verdict's five documented values became nine, with relay-poolable/needs-feedback/design-drained moving to board_column). Adapters must refuse a version they do not know.

unmapped.description: Loud-lossy report: every ledger construct this mapping does not carry. Never empty-by-silence — id:4347 no-silent-swallow.

unmapped_counts.description: construct -> count, so a consumer can assert the lossy surface is shrinking without reading every entry.

repo.description: Repo name — the first half of the composite (repo, id) key.

head_sha.description: The repo HEAD the ledgers were read at, pinned per import by tracker/fleet-import.sh and read back by tracker/fleet-state.py (every state change records `changed_at_sha`/`tombstoned_at_sha` from it). Declared as of 1.1.0: it was load-bearing while undeclared, so nothing cross-checked it. Absent from a single-repo ledger-map.py import, which pins no SHA.

verdict.description: classify-repo.sh's per-repo verdict, VERBATIM. null from ledger-map.py, which does not run the classifier; filled by tracker/repo-entity.py (id:c17d) from control-board.sh --json. null also means 'the classifier produced no verdict for this repo' (producer error) — never an invented value. The `enum` is new in 1.1.0: under 1.0.0 this property had a documented value space but NO enum keyword, so replacing that space (relay-poolable/needs-feedback/design-drained moved to board_column) was invisible to every consumer. ledger-map.py `validate` enforces it — a retired value is now a loud error naming the migration.

board_column.description: control-board.sh's DISPLAY grouping over the verdict enum. Carried alongside `verdict`, never instead of it — the grouping collapses nothing. Set by repo-entity.py (id:c17d). Three of its values (relay-poolable / needs-feedback / design-drained) were `verdict` values under the schema's 1.0.0 prose; the `enum` here and on `verdict` is what makes that migration checkable.

board_label.description: render-verdict.sh's display label for the verdict (idle -> "drained"; every other verdict verbatim). render-verdict.sh is the only sanctioned emitter of "drained". Set by repo-entity.py (id:c17d).

verdict_reason.description: The classifier's `reason` string for this verdict, carried so a null/blocked repo is not a dead end on the board.

counts.description: Open-work counts from the same classify-repo.sh unit. Does NOT carry the `unpromoted` promote/surface counts — `--emit unit` drops them (id:6daf); they arrive here unchanged once that lands.

verdict_source.description: Provenance of `verdict` — which producer it was quoted from.

verdict_generated_at.description: The board's generated_at, so a stale repo entity is visible.

uid.description: '<repo>/<key>' — the composite key. <key> is the 4-hex id for a tracked item, or a '~'-prefixed content hash for an id-less one. 4-hex ids are PER-REPO and never fleet-unique (TODO id:c3f6 caveat 1), so uid — never id — is the primary key.

id.description: The item's own anchored <!-- id:XXXX --> token, or null for an id-less line.

todo_status.description: The TODO.md/TODO.archive.md view's checkbox state. NEVER collapsed with roadmap_status.

roadmap_status.description: The ROADMAP.md/ROADMAP.archive.md view's checkbox state. NEVER collapsed with todo_status.

review_status.description: The REVIEW_ME.md view's box state — a third view, not folded into either ledger view.

drift.description: true iff both ledger views are present and disagree. This is the single-id-two-views drift orphan-scan.sh --cross-ledger reports; the board is the first place it is visible.

derived_status.description: DERIVED for adapters only, never authoritative. An OPEN view always beats a DONE view, so a drifting item is never rendered done.

parent.description: Backward-compat single-parent view: the FIRST entry of `parents` (or null). A line declaring more than one `children-of:` parent is not fully represented here -- read `parents` for the lossless set (id:8302).

parents.description: ALL parents a child-side `<!-- children-of:a,b -->` line declares, in declaration order. `parent` is a convenience alias for `parents[0]` and drops any additional parent (id:8302).

fields.description: The Acceptance / Tests / Done-check / Context sub-bullets.

owner_accepted.description: @owner-accepted:YYYY-MM-DD — owner-only; an importer never writes it, it only carries what the ledger says.

target_uid.description: null until fleet-level resolution. A routed token resolving to >=2 repos is a class-B collision and is FATAL.
